timerSemantics.criticalCorrection: The 609/1/79 partition is the final required-name state from the 180-second Go test result, not a snapshot taken when the 120-second CPU profile stopped.
timerSemantics.profileStartDefinition: TestMain starts CPU profiling, writes full-contract parent provenance, records started=time.Now(), then starts the timer immediately before m.Run(). Compilation and the other five package binaries are outside this profile window.
timerSemantics.profileStopDefinition: At 120 seconds the timer calls StopCPUProfile, joins profile writes, syncs and closes the profile, and writes profile-state. It does not terminate m.Run or change the Go test 180-second timeout.
timerSemantics.requiredCountDefinition: The checker partitions the fixed 689 required top-level names by their final event state at end of the complete captured Go JSON: pass, fail, skip, run/pause as unfinished, or absent as notStarted.
timerSemantics.stepWallDefinition: The 212-second API step wall covers wrapper setup plus version, format, the full Go command, pprof top/cum and export handling; it is not an exact test or package duration.

staticSourceAssessment.testBodyObservation: The sole unfinished top-level body performs setup, reopen, assertions and owner acquisition; its top body contains no loop and no t.Parallel. This does not prove deeper helpers cannot stall or become slow.
staticSourceAssessment.reason: An unfinished test at aggregate timeout is a location marker only. The bounded report has no per-test start timestamp, helper phase marker, stack, or final-60-second CPU evidence.

comparisonWithExact736.scope: Both capacity/foundation workflows, both checker/capture directories, and the six foundation package directories are byte-identical between 736 and 747. Within chengwang/internal, the additions are sealed-archive files under internal/subscription, outside these six-package commands; unrelated joint-control-plane and documentation changes are not treated as gate inputs.
comparisonWithExact736.interpretation: Unchanged source and unchanged timeout have produced both timeout rejection and complete acceptance. This proves run-to-run variability exists. It does not identify the cause, prove a performance fix, or accept exact 747.

scopeSeparation.whyNotTransferable: P207 runs a non-race seven-package selection including subscription, subscriptionctl and subscriptionpolicy; it excludes adapter/mihomo and the failing mihomodeploy package. Foundation/capacity run six packages and include a race command. Same commit does not make these execution scopes interchangeable.
